title: A term the app does not recognise is dated exactly as before the release
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, working in {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Customer {Customer-A} is stored with a credit term text ShopView does not know, {Text-A}, and an invoice {Invoice-A} for it, dated Oct 5, 2026, was created before the release; its due date then, {Date-A}, was written down.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S7-05 Customer, {Text-A} is Prepaid and {Date-A} is Oct 5, 2026.
  • Work order {Work-order-1} for {Customer-A} is complete and ready to invoice.
    For example: {Work-order-1} is S2-15441.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Open {Work-order-1}'s Finance tab.
  2. Set Invoice Date to Oct 5, 2026.
  3. Click Create Invoice.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the invoice preview shows.
  • Step 2: the due date reads {Date-A}, the same as before the release.
  • Step 3: the invoice is created with due date {Date-A}; no error, no blank.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11676 (Story 7, Due dates), story SV-11679 (Story 10, Imports and Public API)

  • S7-N1: “A term whose text ShopView does not recognize (from an old import or the Public API) is dated exactly as today.”
  • S10-R4: “Any other text is saved exactly as sent and dates invoices as it does today (lenient, as today).”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Default Credit Terms" (https://claude.ai/artifact/2erYxWz2ffDNcoXzEfu6wf): canvas pages "9 Invoice due date" (the pages the PRD names for this story). The design (read in full on 23 Oct 2026) does not draw this case's screen or state, so no design picture is attached; the expected results above come from the PRD.

AUTOMATION: HOLD - needs a due date captured on the test site before the release is installed
